script.base: Spread and total are not in the pack, so this flow is form-only: Seattle's defense (3.37 rush YPC, 2 passes of 20+ on 99 attempts, YPA 4.11-5.78) is the stable unit and LAC's defense is the leak (4.00 YPC, 9 of 99 explosives, 9.47 YPA left). pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost because the three-game sums hide a spike: JSN's 405 yards could be one huge game plus two quiet ones, and with no spread the pass-script may be wrong if Seattle just grinds Wilson (32 carries) and Price (28) while LAC brackets JSN into Kupp (101 yards on 10 targets) and Barner (90 on 12), leaving JSN at 7-for-72. Johnston's under is one play from death against a profile of 171 air yards; Seattle has allowed two 20+ throws already, and a third, or a trail-script force-feed on his 17-target role, clears 34.5 by itself. Missing inactives can also cap either snap share. The counter-case is stronger on Johnston than on JSN, which is why that leg stays a lean.
